name: state-managers-comparison
description: Five React state managers, one non-trivial application, measured properly — including the parts where the measurement says nothing.
author: Alexey Yakovlev

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui && tsc --noEmit -p packages/bench && tsc --noEmit -p apps/zustand && tsc --noEmit -p apps/rxjs && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobx && tsc --noEmit -p apps/jotai && tsc --noEmit -p apps/redux && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:apps && playwright test e2e/parity.spec.ts e2e/cross-app-parity.spec.ts
scripts.bench: npm run test:e2e && playwright test e2e/benchmark.spec.ts
scripts.bench:ungated: npm run build:apps && playwright test e2e/benchmark.spec.ts
